name: Telkom SA SOC Ltd
summary: Telkom SA SOC Ltd operates as an integrated communications and information technology (IT) services provider in South Africa, the United States, the United Kingdom, rest of Europe, and internationally. It operates through Openserve, Telkom Consumer, and BCX segments.
